name: Carson Smith
summary: Dog groomer with more than two years of shop experience and a Groom Texas Best First Timer Award. Bring a patient approach to dogs, careful finishing skills, and a commitment to learning.

highlights: Progressed from bathing dogs to averaging two grooms a day alongside other shop duties.
Handle all pre-groom washes and baths in addition to my own grooming appointments.
Shape coats, faces, ears and legs, with scissor finishing, styled topknots and tidy body trims.
Care for boarding dogs and handle daily cleaning throughout the shop.
Help customers at the front desk and operate the register.
Build repeat-client relationships, with customers specifically asking for me at the shop.

award.title: Best First Timer Award
award.description: Earned this award for grooming Fabrice, a Bichon Frise. Featured with Fabrice in Fabrice’s Big Grooming Day, a children’s book by his owner, Michele Stoudt-Wright.

equipment: Own a full toolkit: multiple clippers and blades, premium Foxy Roxy scissors, and a full set of guard combs.
training: Built grooming skills through several courses and daily practice in coat shaping and finishing.
animalExperience: Fostered many puppies and care for my corgi, Beauregard, and horse, Chief Hopper. Began riding at age eight and earned numerous awards in horse jumping.
